Add Store.restock(sku, quantity) to src/inventory/store.py: it adds quantity to an existing item's stock, raises ValueError for a quantity that is not positive, and raises KeyError for an unknown SKU. Add receive(store, note) in a new module src/inventory/receiving.py that applies a delivery note of "sku,quantity" lines with restock and returns how many lines it applied, and export it from the package. A delivery note is applied all or nothing: if any line is bad (malformed, an unknown SKU, or a quantity that is not positive), receive raises and the store is left exactly as it was. Stores hold up to a million items and notes run to thousands of lines, so receive must do a constant amount of work per line beyond restock itself: it must never scan or sort the whole store for a line.
